Class WalletEvents

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.WalletEvents
public final class WalletEvents extends Object
Tells other mods about every change to any wallet: who, how much, why and the balance after. The Quests mod uses it to count slot spins, shop trades and coins earned. Listeners are called on whichever thread changed the wallet, so they must be quick and thread-safe.

A WalletEvents.Veto can stop coins leaving a wallet before it happens (a bet, a purchase, a payment): "no gambling while in jail". Coins being added cannot be stopped, because by then the player may already have handed over items or tickets for them.
